intro_title: A calmer way to see your work.
intro_subtitle: Projects, issues, ideas and their relationships — in one local-first workspace.
intro_privacy: Your data stays on this device. IDIOS works without an account or network connection.
help_intro: Start with a Repository, add Issues, then connect work with sub-issues, prerequisites, Projects and Concepts.
help_repository: Repository — an independent area of work, with its own Issues, labels, milestones and activity.
help_issue: Issue — a task with a status and priority. A Sub-issue is a smaller task owned by a parent Issue.
help_dependency: Prerequisite — use depends_on when one Issue must wait for another. Unfinished prerequisites block starting work.
help_project: Project — groups Issues from different Repositories around one outcome.
help_concept: Concept — reusable knowledge connected to Issues and other Concepts. A concept link does not block work.
help_pr: Pull request — explains the outcome of work. Accepting it records a completion and marks the Issue done; it does not merge real Git code.
help_graph: Graph — explore connections among Repositories, Issues, Projects, Concepts, labels and milestones.
help_notes: Notes — capture a thought now; later link it to an Issue or Repository, or place it in the knowledge graph.
help_seed: Demo data — creates example Repositories, parent/child Issues, dependencies, a Project, Concepts, labels, PRs, activity, notes, quotes and scheduled reminders.
help_shortcuts: Keyboard first: Ctrl+N new, / search, ? help, g graph, r refresh. Tab/Shift+Tab changes sections; Ctrl+Tab or F6 focuses buttons; ↑/↓ moves focus; Enter activates; Esc backs out; q quits.
settings_font_note: Terminal font family and font size are controlled by your terminal application. IDIOS can change its theme, colors, density and control layout.
notes_empty: No notes yet. Add a note before the idea escapes.
jobs_empty: No scheduled jobs yet. Add a reminder for your next review.
